narrative: Teams, repos, and org-level rulesets are now declared as YAML and applied through a Python CLI — no Terraform state, no infra/ directory. An operator runs `gw plan` to see a structured diff, `gw apply --json` to converge the org, and `gw reset` to restore defaults. The entire TF toolchain is gone from CI and docs; the org is the source of truth, driven by code.
